infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FranchiseIQ uses the camera to analyze the street while you walk a site survey.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FranchiseIQ uses the microphone for live voice with the AI co-pilot.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FranchiseIQ attaches GPS to each survey frame for block-level data.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow FranchiseIQ to use the camera for site surveys.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow FranchiseIQ to use the microphone for voice.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow FranchiseIQ to record your location with each survey frame.
